hero.lead: A collectible art card deck opening a gateway into an alternative mythology where alchemy, history and modernity intertwine.
hero.body: Each card is a fragment of this world — an artwork, a character and a story to explore, interpret and play with.

worlds_section.label: The Deck's Mythology
worlds_section.title: 4 worlds in 54 paintings
worlds_section.lead: Magister is a full 54-card art deck. Suits are not decorative trim — each one is a realm with its own laws, cast, and symbolism. Ranks and houses are woven into the painting itself: you read the card by looking, not by corner indices.

hearts.name: Hearts — Olympian gods
hearts.blurb: The classical pantheon in motion: desire, metamorphosis, oracle and flame. Hearts carry mythic episodes where mortals and immortals negotiate fate.

diamonds.name: Diamonds — Bearers of secrets
diamonds.blurb: Alchemical emissaries, hidden orders, and whispers behind crowns. Diamonds track those who traffic in knowledge that should not travel in plain sight.

clubs.name: Clubs — Knights Templar
clubs.blurb: Crusade steel, lost treasure-maps, and the long shadow of the order. Clubs anchor the deck in medieval intrigue and the arc from devotion to legend.

spades.name: Spades — Celebrities & icons
spades.blurb: Modern myth-making: faces the world thought it knew, reframed as archetypes. Spades ask what happens when public masks become permanent emblems.

gallery.label: The Collection
gallery.title: Explore the deck
gallery.lead: Every card is a story. The deck contains 54 original artworks, each opening another fragment of the Magister Cards universe.

authors.label: Authors
authors.title: The people who brought Magister Cards to life

pochitsky.name: Vasil Pochitsky
pochitsky.bio: Belarusian painter, illustrator and musician. Started painting in Rechitsa, and went on to exhibit from Moscow to New York; for nearly a decade his drawings ran in the national press, and he illustrated books and records throughout his career. Magister — signed, as he signed this whole body of work, Dr. Klein — is his most ambitious cycle: fifty-four paintings completed near the end of his life.

zhilchik.name: Alexander Zhilchik
zhilchik.role: Author of the Idea · IP Owner
zhilchik.bio: Conceived the full mythology behind Magister — the houses, characters and historical threads that connect all fifty-four cards into one universe. Zhilchik owns the IP outright: no co-authors, no other rights to clear, nothing for a partner to untangle.
